text.p: -- JP Morgan has reiterated its buy recommendation on Anadarko Petroleum Corp and has a nine to 12 month price target for the stock of $73 compared with $57-1/2 currently.

-- "We believe that Anadarko merits a 15 percent premium (to prospective net asset value) in light of development plans in 1997 which should prove up much of its unbooked reserves from the recent discoveries in the Gulf of Mexico subsalts and a meaningful exploratory drilling program compsed of five new prospects in the Gulf of Mexico and 12 exploratory wells in Algeria," analyst Michael Cha said.
-- Anadarko will spend $300 million on development drilling this year and $159 million on exploratory drilling. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
